title: Brush Brush Shiny Teeth | Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes, Toothbrushing Song for Children | BuBu TV - English
description:
A cheerful kids' song about brushing teeth together every morning, with a little giggle when toothpaste goes everywhere!
It teaches children a pea-size amount of toothpaste and brushing for two minutes so their smiles stay bright and healthy.
Sing along and make brushing time fun for little ones!

Brush brush up, brush brush down
Round and round we go
Swish, swish, swish, swish
Shiny teeth, hello!

Brother squeezes, squeeze, squeeze, squeeze
Toothpaste on his nose
Squirt, squirt, squirt, squirt
Sister giggles, "Oh no!"

Yellow duck goes quack, quack, quack
Amma shows a pea-size dab
Two, two minutes, brush, brush, brush
One, two, all done!

Big shiny smiles in the mirror
Amma claps, "Well done!"
Ting ting ting ting
Shiny teeth, all done!
